The ManyChat REST API exposes Page, Sending, and Subscriber operations for Facebook Messenger automation (a separate Profile API endpoint is available for white-label flows). Endpoints derived from the public Swagger document served at https://api.manychat.com/swagger. Authentication is via a Bearer token of the form `Bearer <page-id>:<api-key>` generated in the ManyChat dashboard.
